text:
maya: Heads up — seeing a spike in eval fail rate on staging after deploying AWQ with act-quant enabled + group_size=128. Rolling canary now. Sample quality delta ~6% on Winograd eval.

aisha: On it. Can you share canary id and the quant config?

maya: Canary id c-202603-176850. Config snippet below, but results look noisier and some hallucinations popped up on long-context prompts.

```
model: gpt-4o-mini
quant:
  method: AWQ
  group_size: 128
  act_quant: true
  percdamp: 0.02
```

jon: I ran a small local sweep yesterday — group=64 + act_quant=true was fine. group=128 seems to increase token-level BLEU drop and sometimes changes completion brevity. Could be accumulation/rounding across KV-cache updates. :thinking:

li: Logs from canary show a handful of softmax temp anomalies and a couple of transient OOMs on host-3 around 14:03 UTC. Snip: 

```
[14:03:12] host-3 kernel_awq_fwd: WARN softmax_denorm > 1e6, clamping
[14:03:12] host-3 kv_cache: WARN write_latency_ms=42
[14:03:13] host-3 oom: attempted allocate 512MB, available 384MB
```

deploy-bot: Canary c-202603-176850 - auto-fallback triggered by eval threshold (delta_winograd > 4%). Rollback started. :arrow_backward:

maya: I've reverted staging to AWQ group_size=64. Still seeing intermittent flakiness where prefix caching + grouping interacts (repro steps attached in the canary ticket).

aisha: @jon can we try a quick AB with group_size=96? Might be a middle ground between perf and stability.

jon: Yes. Launching a 1h AB: 20% traffic -> group=96, 80% -> group=64. Using same seeds and prompt corpus. Command I ran: 

```
ci run ab-test --canary c-202603-176850 --variants '{"g96":96,"g64":64}' --duration 3600
```

li: Also kicking off a variant with act_quant=false on g128 to isolate whether act-quant or group size is the culprit.

maya: Collect these eval metrics: perplexity, winograd_acc, BLEU, and token drift. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/experiments/1768504322 :eyes:

ci-bot: AB test started, will post a summary at 1768507922.

aisha: If we still see regression, we should pin serving runtime to kernel_v3 — it had fewer FP corner cases in last perf cycle. cc @sam (eng-runtime). :hammer:

sam: On it. I'm preparing a patch to disable the new fused AWQ kernel on canary hosts and will smoke test perf impact. If perf delta < 5% we can roll that forward while we debug numeric stability.

maya: Thanks everyone — please paste any failing example outputs into the ticket and add short labels (hallucination/format-loss/truncation) so we can triage quickly. :chart_with_upwards_trend: :shrug:
